headline: New top text, above the card
lede: Forty-five LinkedIn organic posts from Bill's profile. The photograph, the white card and the card's position are untouched. What varies is the text above it and the caption, across nine message themes with five variants each.
note: The top text here is composited over the exported image so all 45 can be read without building 45 frames. Character counts are live against the 24-per-line headline and 58-character CTA limits. Nothing is scheduled and nothing is gated.

themes.name: How clients arrive
themes.claim: A large share of investors at your best clients' asset tier arrived with no referral involved. The campaign's leading argument, and the theme Rania added when free was cut.

themes.name: What prospects see
themes.claim: They look you up before they call. All five sit above the 96% card, because that is the behavior the figure describes.

themes.name: Measure what you already spend
themes.claim: If the firm already pays for search work, the benchmark is a second read on a line item it already funds. Bill's required arc beat.

themes.name: Specific to you
themes.claim: Your firm, your metro, your competitors, discovered from the market rather than curated. Ownership rather than rigor.

themes.name: The third leg
themes.claim: Referrals and centers of influence are the first two legs and they still carry the book. The third is the one a firm can build. Never above the 25% card.

themes.name: Speed
themes.claim: Thirty seconds of the reader's time. Two fields. The report arrives about ten minutes later, and those ten minutes are never the reader's.

themes.name: Autonomous
themes.claim: Nothing is scheduled and no call gets booked. Absorbs the no-catch reassurance that the cut free theme used to carry. It never promises we will not reach out.

themes.name: Marketing engineering
themes.claim: The work is a practice with several disciplines in it, not one person's job. Presses the complexity of the practice, never the competence of the reader's current person.

themes.name: Depth of the analysis
themes.claim: What is in the report: keyword by keyword, five firms scored the same way, the site read the way a crawler reads it, and a short priority list.

themes.name: If you're — conditional address
themes.claim: Bill's direction off a live Hormozi ad: an "If you're..." conditional that lets the reader self-select on a specific pain and lands on an invitation, rather than telling him what he has wrong. Its own treatment at 62px replacing both the headline and the CTA, since the conditional carries its own invitation. Five state the $500M floor inside the sentence; eight take the provenance line beneath instead, and that split is the A/B.
